values.note: $25 per site; two vehicles or one RV included, $10 for a third vehicle. Same in the 2027 rate table. Cash, check or money order in the self-service fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/bear-lake-campground ('Single Site: $25 per night', '$10 fee for a third vehicle'; last updated February 3, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/254080/rates (2026 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 25), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'open late May to late September, weather dependent'. 2026 dates are recreation.gov's fee seasons (first-come May 22 - June 11, reservable June 12 - Sept 12, first-come Sept 13-26).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/bear-lake-campground ('This campground is open late May to late September, weather dependent.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/254080/rates (2026 seasons 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-26), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/254080 ('No electric or septic hook-ups are available') + campsite catalog for 254080 (all sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water/Sewer Hookup No), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 13 public sites besides the host's (10 reservable, 3 first-come); max vehicle lengths 22-36 ft, all back-in.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 254080 (13 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites excluding 001 MANAGEMENT; Max Vehicle Length 22-36, Driveway Entry Back-In; site 013 is the host) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/254080 ('This rustic campground has 14 campsites'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump. Firewood sold by the camp host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/bear-lake-campground ('2 accessible outhouses'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/254080 ('Vault toilets and drinking water are available'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov for the 2026 peak season June 12 - Sept 12; first-come before and after, and 3 sites are always first-come (must be occupied the first night). recreation.gov closes booking 4 days before arrival. No minimum stay (recreation.gov's weekend/holiday minimums are 0). 14 consecutive nights at most.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/254080 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 0 soft, minHolidayWeekendStay 0 soft, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'First-come, first-served campsites are available') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 06-12 to 09-12) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/bear-lake-campground ('Limited sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run sites).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/bear-lake-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-26

note: Culebra Range above Cuchara (San Carlos RD, Pike-San Isabel NF) at 10,480 ft, 5 miles up FSR 422 off CO-12, 1 mile past Blue Lake Campground; trailhead for the Indian Trail motorized system. A 2022 windstorm blew down many trees (cleared 2024), so the campground is more open and can be very windy. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (2026 and 2027), no hookups, 13 sites, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed max_rig_ft 60 -> 36 (catalog Max Vehicle Length 22-36; the 60 was a driveway length), pull_through false. Added season late May - late Sept (05-22 to 09-26), reservable season 06-12 to 09-12, some sites FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 14-night limit, vault toilets, hand-pump water, senior/access 50%. No current alert on FSR 422.
